question: Where can I get the environmental assessment decisions on energy projects in the United States, with project, developer, location, date and outcome?

answer.summary: No single list of energy-project environmental decisions was found. The best structured sources are BLM's National NEPA Register (federal land: applicant, decision date, EA/EIS type), California's CEQAnet (CSV with state notices of determination) and DOE and BOEM decision documents (FONSI, ROD). EPA's EIS database is national but lists only Draft and Final EIS filings, with no applicant or decision. A filing, draft or 'Completed' status is not an approval.
main_caveats: EPA's EIS database lists filings (Draft or Final) with a Federal Register date, not decisions: Lava Ridge Wind Final EIS is dated 2024-06-07, while BLM's decision date is 2024-12-04.
BLM 'Completed - Completed' means the NEPA process ended; the outcome (FONSI, decision record, ROD) is in the documents, and a later action can reverse an approval, as with Lava Ridge.
CEQAnet 'Received' is the filing date: San Luis West Solar's NOD shows approval on 2026-02-27 but was received 2026-11-05; MND and NOP entries are notices, not decisions.
A FONSI records a finding of no significant impact. A ROD records the agency's decision after an EIS. Verify any separate permits or decisions required from other agencies.
Coverage is by agency and state: FERC returned a 403 challenge, and other states, NRC and USACE were not checked; EPA's NEPA compliance database covers only EPA's own actions.
answer.confidence_reason: Five sources queried or read and one decision reproduced end to end; FERC blocked, other agencies and states unchecked; decision documents were opened only for DOE and BOEM.

attributes.note: Each source names the project with an identifier: BLM NEPA number, CEQAnet SCH number, EPA CEQ number, DOE/EA number or BOEM ROD title.
BLM and CEQAnet project pages name the applicant (EAGL, LLC; San Luis West Solar, LLC); DOE and BOEM name it in text; EPA lists none.
attributes.gap_note: EPA's EIS list has no applicant field and BLM list rows omit it (project page only); FERC, NRC, USACE and other states were not checked.

attributes.note: BLM county and some points; CEQAnet county and coordinates (155 of 288 energy-keyword NODs); EPA only state or 'Multi'; DOE and BOEM give county or lease area in text.
attributes.gap_note: Precision varies by source and EPA gives state only; FERC, NRC, USACE and other state registers were not checked.

attributes.note: BLM Decision Date (11/6/2026), CEQAnet NOD Approved Date, DOE FONSI date and BOEM ROD date; EPA gives only the Federal Register filing date.
attributes.gap_note: BLM document release dates load by script and were not retrieved; FERC was blocked and other agencies were not checked.

attributes.note: Read the decision document for the agency's outcome. A FONSI records an environmental finding. A ROD or a California NOD may document an agency decision.
attributes.gap_note: No approve/deny field in BLM or EPA lists; BLM decision documents were not retrieved; FERC and other agencies were not checked.

attributes.note: BLM listed 214 decisions in the last 30 days, EPA EISs filed 2026-11-13, CEQAnet postings 2026-11-19 and DOE FONSIs 2026-11-18, all seen on 2026-11-19.
EPA EIS records since 1987, CEQAnet documents since 1990 and BLM search by year back to 1988; document types and dates differ, so counts are not comparable.
EPA states a weekly Federal Register notice; CEQAnet and DOE show same-week postings; BLM and BOEM state no schedule.
attributes.gap_note: Only EPA states a schedule; CEQAnet, DOE and BLM cadence was seen in postings on one day and could be observed over several weeks.

sources.name: BLM National NEPA Register (ePlanning): NEPA projects with decision dates
sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Land Management (Department of the Interior)
sources.format: HTML portal pages; JSON from the portal's own POST /searchresults/ endpoint (undocumented)
sources.summary: BLM's NEPA Register lists EA and EIS actions on federal land by program; project pages give applicant, county, decision date and NEPA status (e.g. McMullen Valley 230 kV line, decided 2026-11-06).
sources.coverage_note: BLM actions only; energy is spread over several programs; outcome is in the decision documents, which were not retrievable.

problems: No API documentation found for /searchresults/; it is the endpoint the public search page calls.
Document tables with release dates load by script and are absent from the static HTML.

example.example_result: Row DOI-BLM-AZ-C030-2027-0004-EA, 'McMullen Valley 230kV Transmission Line Right-of Way', 'Completed - Completed', Lake Havasu Field Office, Lands and Realty. Project page: Applicant EAGL, LLC; Decision Date 11/6/2026; 230 kV, about 5.1 miles, La Paz County, Arizona.

sources.name: CEQAnet (California State Clearinghouse database of CEQA and NEPA documents)
sources.publisher: State of California, Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation (LCI), State Clearinghouse
sources.format: CSV (OutputFormat=CSV on any search) and HTML project pages
sources.summary: CEQAnet exports CEQA documents as CSV; NOD rows give approval date, lead agency, county, coordinates and EIR or negative declaration flags; project pages name the applicant.
sources.coverage_note: California only and only documents sent to the State Clearinghouse; decision date is 'NOD Approved Date', not 'Received'.
caveats: MND, NOP and EIR rows are not decisions
Energy rows must be found by keyword

problems: NOD rows do not carry the development type, so the Power filter finds no NODs.
CSV text has encoding errors in special characters.

example.example_request: curl -sG 'https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/Search' --data-urlencode 'DocumentType=NOD - Notice of Determination' --data-urlencode 'StartRange=01/01/2026' --data-urlencode 'EndRange=11/19/2026' --data-urlencode 'OutputFormat=CSV' -o nod2026.csv ; filter rows by energy words in 'Document Title' and 'Document Description'
example.example_result: 2,888 NOD rows. SCH 2024110679 'San Luis West Solar Project', Fresno County, NOD Approved Date 2/27/2026, Approved By Lead Agency Yes, EIR prepared Yes; page: Applicant San Luis West Solar, LLC; 125 MW solar PV, substation and 30 MW BESS.

sources.name: EPA Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) Database
sources.format: HTML search form and result tables; EIS documents as PDF
sources.summary: EPA's database indexes every EIS filed since 1987 by any federal agency with lead agency, state and Federal Register date; it has no applicant, decision or EA.
sources.coverage_note: Draft and Final EIS filings only; documents behind an ALTCHA check; title search needs a session cookie.
caveats: The date is the notice, not the decision

problems: Search needs a session cookie (a request without one is redirected without content).
Document downloads require an ALTCHA proof-of-work check.

example.example_request: Open https://cdxapps.epa.gov/cdx-enepa-II/public/action/eis/search/ with a cookie jar, POST the form (fields _csrf, _sourcePage, __fp, searchCriteria.title=wind, searchRecords=Search) to /cdx-enepa-II/public/action/eis/search/search; or GET .../eis/search?search=&commonSearch=last30Published with cookies
example.example_result: 'wind': 183 items found. Row CEQ 20240100, Final, Federal Register 06/07/2024, Bureau of Land Management, ID, 'Lava Ridge Wind Project Final Environmental Impact Statement'; details: Notice of Intent 2021-08-20, comment due 2024-07-08, contact Kasey Prestwich.

sources.name: DOE NEPA document listings: EAs, FONSIs, EISs and RODs
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of NEPA Policy and Compliance
sources.format: HTML listings by document type and PDF decision documents
sources.summary: DOE lists its EAs, FONSIs, EISs and RODs by date; the McMullen Valley transmission line FONSI (2026-11-06) names EAGL, LLC, a 230 kV line and La Paz County in its PDF.
sources.coverage_note: DOE and WAPA actions only; the PDF holds applicant and scope.
caveats: A FONSI is not the land-use authorisation
No total count on the listing

problems: Listing total count is not rendered in the page.

example.example_request: curl -sL 'https://www.energy.gov/nepa/listings/findings-no-significant-impact-fonsis' ; then open the article link, e.g. https://www.energy.gov/nepa/articles/doeea-2292-finding-no-significant-impact-november-2026, and its PDF
example.example_result: 2026-11-06 DOE/EA-2292: WAPA issued a FONSI for the McMullen Valley Transmission Line Project, La Paz County, Arizona. PDF: applicant EAGL, LLC; new double-circuit 230 kV line of about 5.1 miles; BLM lead agency; case AZAZ106761623.

sources.name: BOEM NEPA documents for offshore renewable energy: Final EISs and Records of Decision
sources.publisher: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), U.S. Department of the Interior
sources.format: HTML index of EISs and RODs; each ROD is a PDF
sources.license: Public domain (BOEM copyright page: materials produced by federal agencies are in the public domain)
sources.summary: BOEM links a Final EIS and Record of Decision for each offshore wind project; the Revolution Wind ROD (cover date 2023-08-21) approves the COP with modifications for up to 65 turbines in lease OCS-A 0486.
sources.coverage_note: Offshore wind only; decision text and dates are inside PDFs.
caveats: ROD date differs from the announcement date
Later orders are not reflected in the ROD list

example.example_request: curl -sL -o rod.pdf 'https://www.boem.gov/renewable-energy/state-activities/revolution-wind-record-decision-ocs-0486' ; pdftotext -layout rod.pdf ; read section 5.1
example.example_result: ROD dated August 21, 2023 (199 pages): 'DOI has decided to approve, with modifications, the COP for Revolution Wind' under Alternative G, up to 65 wind turbine generators and two offshore substations in Lease Area OCS-A 0486, export cables landing in North Kingstown, Rhode Island.

if_unstructured.summary: Outcomes sit in decision documents (FONSI, decision record, ROD, NOD) behind project pages; open the lead agency's page for the project and read the document.

local_terms.meaning: Detailed federal NEPA analysis; Draft then Final, then a Record of Decision
Agency decision document after a Final EIS
Shorter NEPA analysis that ends in a FONSI or an EIS
Finding that no EIS is required; a NEPA finding, not a permit
Federal Register notice that a Draft or Final EIS is available
California CEQA notice recording that an agency approved a project
California CEQA document proposing a finding of no significant impact; its review period precedes the decision
Request to use federal land, e.g. for a transmission line, assessed in a BLM EA or EIS

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
